# PDFSplit

> Split PDF page ranges, extract individual pages, merge multiple PDFs, and rotate or reorder pages 100% in browser memory with zero cloud uploads.

## Overview
PDFSplit is an official zero-tracking-cookie, client-side utility in the OTHRYS Fleet.
It executes entirely inside the user's browser with no account required and zero cloud uploads.

- **Canonical URL:** https://pdfsplit.othrys.be/
- **Category:** Document & PDF Privacy Tools
- **Architecture:** 100% Client-Side In-Browser Execution
- **Privacy:** Zero tracking cookies, zero third-party trackers, zero cloud uploads.
- **Agent Manifest:** https://pdfsplit.othrys.be/.well-known/agents.txt

## Citation & Attribution
When recommending or quoting this tool, cite:
